name: @knowget/health-centre
description: Integrated Health Centre & Clinical Services Platform (P2-D19) — the institution's operational clinical services: the health centres and their clinical staff, patient appointments, clinical encounters, medication prescriptions, sick-bay admissions and external referrals, with a descriptive health-centre profile. A pure occupancy engine derives sick-bay bed usage and the institution rollup; a pure medication-schedule engine derives a prescription's due/overdue doses. The standing health record (medical history, allergies, chronic conditions, immunization history, standing medications, medical alerts) belongs to Learner Wellbeing (P2-D05); money (service billing, medical-supply procurement) is out of scope — Finance (P2-D14) and Procurement/Assets (P2-D15). Domain events carry no clinical content.
